resolvedQuestions: What drove the measured Jev result?
How can accuracy improve or cost fall?
How can the measurement become more trustworthy?
Where else in .skilled would the same judgment pay off?
What would default-on integration need, cost, and risk?

keyFindings.title: The keep clears every gate, with the sign test binding
The chosen baseline is the majority class at exactly K/3
The corpus hard-codes the miss and disables the loose rule
The measured population is the outputs file, not the fixtures
Jev scored a unanimous stable column on this population
Labels equal the author's intent on all 24 rows
The protocol costs 3 calls per miss plus an auth call, serially
Order rotation bought no accuracy on this corpus
Cost is unrecorded even though the client reports usage
A cache precedent exists in the same pipeline and is unused here
The regex is narrower than plausible natural formats and this corpus cannot price a widening
The production grader path is process-heavy versus the hosted Jev arm
The corpus is synthetic and built to defeat both zero-call readers
Labels are author intent re-read with no per-row decisions record
The keep's uncertainty is wide at 24 rows
Both baselines sit at their floor by construction
The report records corpus identity but not instrument identity or provenance
Natural-miss prevalence is unmeasured and no instrument produces it
The measurement's mechanical foundations are sound
The direct production home is the reviewer grader slot
The residue flagger emits its own miss list
The deliverable extractor has an explicit low-confidence fall-through
Two more sub-scorers carry the shape, one Jev-validated
Runtime completion detection is a deliberate non-candidate
The reusable assets are the discipline, not the transport
Default-on has one concrete home and it is inert today
The minimum integration surface is small and enumerable
Reference-design cost is small at benchmark volume and the one-call variant is recomputable
The risk ledger is ordered by corpus validity first
The measurement-to-integration loop is designed end to end and unexercised
Final ranked recommendations issued

ruledOutDirections: Treat the 8-case fixture census as the fallback population.
Treat loose 0 of 24 as a property of the loose rule alone.
Treat p_win=0.00001526 as an error probability.
Treat the three-order protocol as free accuracy on this population.
Treat a regex widening as measurable on the current corpus.
Treat the printed token estimate as measured cost.
Treat 24 of 24 as establishing a usable precision level.
Treat the two zero-call baselines as realistic competitors.
Treat the labels as independent ground truth.
Treat already-measured 047 features as transfer answers.
Replace the artifact-based completion check with a model read.
Flip the grader default on the current corpus.
